title: 第三章  进山打猎收获颇丰第四章  何须卖身男儿自强
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 老者常松一下被惊醒了过来，下意识抬头看向陆川。
几息过后，他看清来人，目光落在陆川身后长弓上，眉头微皱，
“小川儿，你这是……要把你爹留下的弓卖了？”
陆川连忙摇头。
“常伯，我买些箭矢，去三重山打猎。”
“打猎？”
常松满脸狐疑。
他年轻时也是猎户，和陆川父亲结伴进山多年，两家交情不错，对于陆川的性子更是心知肚明。
这小子就是个文弱书生，整日埋首书本，农活不沾，别说打猎，连鸡都不敢杀。
听闻陆川要进山打猎这话，简直比见着太阳打西边出来还要稀奇。
“小川儿，进山打猎可不是闹着玩。”
常松看在故人面子上，语气严厉的告诫道：
“打不着猎物是小事，要是撞见大虫、熊瞎子，你这条小命就得撂在山里。你连那张桑木弓都拉不开，去了也是白费力气。”
“谢谢常伯，我行事会多加小心。”
陆川道谢，但丝毫没有放下进山的打算。
常松见陆川心意已决，只能暗叹一声，出言道：
“十只硬木箭，收你五十文钱。要是其他人，少说得多上两成价。”
陆川又道谢一声，一手接过箭矢，一手递出银钱，转身就要离开。
“等等！”
常松忽然喊住他。
“小川，其实参军也不全是坏处。军中会免费传授基础武学，你若去别处学，少说也要几十两白银。”
“我那二小子，前两年应征入伍，如今已是武道一境练皮境，当上了小旗官。你要是去了，他多少能照料你一二。”
前几天陆川投河的事，闹得全镇皆知。
常松看着他长大，终究心软，多劝了几句，
“在军中，练皮境就能担任小旗官。若是能更上一层楼，达到武道二境练肉境，再立下点战功，便可以升任总旗，总领半百兵卒。”
常松显然知道不少内幕消息，又给陆川吐露出不少实情，
“我那二小子前一阵子托人传讯，军中的大人对他颇为欣赏。”
常松话头一转，又说到他参军的二子，语气中满是骄傲。
陆川闻言一愣，军中会传授武道？
按照常松所说，武道境界前两个境界分别是练皮境、练肉境。
武道有成，地位权利唾手可得。
一时间，他心中涌现出了对武道的向往。
“谢谢常伯，我会好好考虑的。”
陆川没有辜负常松的好意，顺势承下了人情。
陆川告别常松，又往空地上去。
在练习了数十次箭术后，陆川这才停下手，往家里赶去。
回到家中，桌面放着一碟小菜，两碗糙米饭。
跟叶莞君招呼一声，两人开始默默吃起饭来。
陆川狼吞虎咽，很快便将碗里饭菜扫空。
放下碗筷，陆川灌下一大碗凉水，看向叶莞君。
“我尽量天黑前回来，晚上别出门，把门窗锁好。”
嘱咐几句，他不再犹豫，转身出门，认准三重山方向，快步而去。
叶莞君望着他渐行渐远的背影，抬手捂住胸口，眼里满是担忧。
她没阻止陆川进山打猎，也没抱多少希望，只盼他能平平安安回来。
陆川走后，叶莞君从床铺底下摸出积蓄，细细数了数，只有二两多碎银。
content_en:
The old man Chang Song was woken up and subconsciously looked up at Lu Chuan.
After a few breaths, he saw the person coming clearly. His eyes fell on the long bow behind Lu Chuan, and he frowned slightly.
"Xiao Chuan'er, are you...going to sell the bow your father left behind?"
Lu Chuan shook his head quickly.
"Uncle Chang, I'll buy some arrows and go hunting in Sanchong Mountain."
"Hunting?"
Chang Song looked suspicious.
He was also an Orion hunter when he was young, and he had been in the mountains with Lu Chuan's father for many years. The two families had a good relationship, and he knew Lu Chuan's temperament well.
This boy is just a weak scholar. He keeps his head buried in books all day long and does not do farm work. Let alone hunting, he does not even dare to kill chickens.
Hearing that Lu Chuan was going to go hunting in the mountains was even more surprising than seeing the sun rise in the west.
"Xiao Chuan'er, going hunting in the mountains is no joke."
Chang Song looked at his old friend's face and warned him sternly:
"It's a trivial matter not to be able to catch prey. If you encounter a big insect or a blind bear, your life will be lost in the mountains. You can't even draw the mulberry bow, so it's all in vain."
"Thank you, Uncle Chang. I will be more careful when I act."
Lu Chuan thanked him, but he had no intention of going into the mountains.
Seeing that Lu Chuan had made up his mind, Chang Song could only sigh secretly and said:
"Ten hardwood arrows will cost you fifty cents. If it were anyone else, the price would be 20% more."
Lu Chuan thanked him again, took the arrow with one hand, handed out the money with the other, and turned to leave.
"Wait!"
Chang Song suddenly called him.
"Ogawa, actually joining the army is not all bad. The army will teach you basic martial arts for free. If you go to learn it elsewhere, it will cost you dozens of taels of silver at least."
"My second son was drafted into the army two years ago. Now he is at the first level of martial arts and skin training, and has become a small flag officer. If you go, he can take care of you to some extent."
The whole town knew about Lu Chuan's drowning in the river a few days ago.
Chang Song watched him grow up, and finally softened his heart and persuaded him a few more times.
"In the army, one can serve as a small flag officer at the level of skin training. If one can go to the next level and reach the second level of martial arts, meat training level, and achieve some military exploits, he can be promoted to the general banner and command half a hundred soldiers."
Chang Song obviously knew a lot of inside information and revealed a lot of truth to Lu Chuan.
"My second boy was summoned for questioning a while ago, and the adults in the army quite admired him."
Chang Song changed the subject and talked about his second son who joined the army, his tone full of pride.
Lu Chuan was stunned when he heard this. Will martial arts be taught in the army?
According to Chang Song, the first two realms of martial arts are the skin training realm and the flesh training realm.
If you are successful in martial arts, you will have status and power at your fingertips.
For a moment, a yearning for martial arts emerged in his heart.
"Thank you, Uncle Chang. I will think about it carefully."
Lu Chuan lived up to Chang Song's kindness and accepted the favor.
Lu Chuan said goodbye to Chang Song and went up to the open space again.
After practicing archery dozens of times, Lu Chuan stopped and rushed home.
When I got home, there was a plate of side dishes and two bowls of brown rice on the table.
After greeting Ye Wanjun, the two of them began to eat in silence.
Lu Chuan wolfed down the food and quickly emptied the bowl.
Putting down his bowl and chopsticks, Lu Chuan drank a large bowl of cold water and looked at Ye Wanjun.
"I'll try to come back before dark, don't go out at night, and lock the doors and windows."
After a few instructions, he no longer hesitated, turned around and went out, looking in the direction of Sanchong Mountain, and walked away quickly.
Ye Wanjun looked at his retreating back, raised his hand to cover his chest, his eyes full of worry.
She didn't stop Lu Chuan from going hunting in the mountains, and she didn't hold out much hope. She just hoped that he would come back safely.
After Lu Chuan left, Ye Guanjun took out his savings from under the bed and counted them carefully, only two taels of silver.
title_en: Chapter 3: Hunting in the mountains is fruitful Chapter 4: Why sell yourself to be a man to improve yourself
